title: When the Regiment Falls
author: Petra Okafor
blurb: Lena Nystrom, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
